content: APPROVE. Independent evidence: 11/11 labeler::rotation lib tests pass (1 ignored: os_keychain requires real keychain daemon). Build + clippy + fmt clean. Subagent's KMS deviation from pre-flight (CreateKey+UpdateAlias instead of GenerateDataKeyPair) is correct — GenerateDataKeyPair returns plaintext-encrypted-keypair which AwsKmsSigner can't sign through; CreateKey produces a KMS-resident asymmetric CMK that kms:Sign routes through. UpdateAlias is the atomic alias-swap primitive. Passphrase from POLARIS_SIGNING_PASSPHRASE env only. State-machine surface unchanged. CLI binary extended with --account, --kms-region, --kms-alias flags.
